parts.title: Start here
parts.intro: Where everything fits, and a first course in rays for readers new to optics.

chapters.title: Orientation
chapters.intro: From Maxwell's equations down to rays with the modules for each level of approximation and checks of all sign conventions, and a first course in geometrical optics.

parts.title: Waves: propagation, beams and coherence
parts.intro: Fields between planes, from the angular spectrum to tilted planes and inhomogeneous media; Gaussian and structured beams; coherence.

chapters.title: Free-space propagation
chapters.intro: Scalar and vectorial propagation of fields between planes, onto tilted planes and through inhomogeneous media.

chapters.title: Beams and modes
chapters.intro: Gaussian and structured beams, ABCD matrices and resonators, beam quality, mode decompositions and ultrashort pulses.

chapters.title: Coherence
chapters.intro: Spatial and temporal coherence, and how they measure stars.

parts.title: Light in matter
parts.intro: Interfaces, thin films and polarization; anisotropic crystals and the modulators built from them; full-wave Maxwell solvers (FDTD and FDFD) for structures on the scale of the wavelength.

chapters.title: Interfaces and thin films
chapters.intro: Fresnel coefficients, multilayer stacks and coatings.

chapters.title: Polarization, crystals and modulators
chapters.intro: Jones and Mueller calculus, anisotropic and gyrotropic media, and the devices that switch and steer light with them.

chapters.title: FDTD
chapters.intro: Full-wave solutions of Maxwell's equations on the Yee grid in the time domain (`fdtd`).

chapters.title: FDFD and nanophotonics
chapters.intro: Maxwell's equations one frequency at a time (`fdfd`): resonances, microcavities and a carpet cloak.

parts.title: Imaging and microscopy
parts.intro: How an image forms and how good it is: diffraction orders and the pupil, PSF, MTF and Strehl, Zernike aberrations, image processing; then the microscope and its contrast methods.

chapters.title: Image formation and quality
chapters.intro: Abbe's diffraction orders and the pupil, PSF, MTF and Strehl ratio, Zernike and other bases, image processing and restoration.

chapters.title: Microscopy
chapters.intro: Contrast methods, confocal and super-resolution microscopy, Fourier ptychography and optical traps.

parts.title: Ray tracing and lens design
parts.intro: Sequential ray tracing and aberration theory, optimization and tolerancing, aspheres and diffractive surfaces, complete lens systems, stray light, and the bridge between rays and waves.

chapters.title: Ray tracing basics
chapters.intro: Sequential ray tracing to the wavefront, Seidel aberrations, the sine and Herschel conditions, telecentricity, glasses, Delano diagrams, polarization ray tracing and GRIN media.

chapters.title: Optimization and tolerancing
chapters.intro: Damped least squares, several configurations, the landscape of local minima, Monte Carlo tolerancing, polishing errors and CAD export.

chapters.title: Aspheres and special surfaces
chapters.intro: Forbes Q polynomials, Fresnel lenses and diffractive surfaces.

chapters.title: Lens systems
chapters.intro: Complete designs: a phone camera lens, zoom lenses, eyepieces and binoculars, scan lenses, spectacle lenses and off-axis mirror systems.

chapters.title: Stray light
chapters.intro: Non-sequential ray tracing, ghosts and scatter.

chapters.title: Rays and waves
chapters.intro: Converting between ray ensembles and wave fields: ray field summation, foci of real lenses, Gaussian beamlets, DOEs and the eye.

chapters.title: Field tracing
chapters.intro: Rays through the lenses, waves where diffraction matters: chains of propagation operators chosen step by step.

parts.title: Metrology and computational imaging
parts.intro: Measuring phase, surfaces and films: interferometers, wavefront sensors, ellipsometry and scatterometry, holography, phase retrieval and imaging without lenses.

chapters.title: Interferometry
chapters.intro: Phase from fringes, unwrapping, optical testing of spheres and aspheres, white light interferometry and OCT.

chapters.title: Wavefront and slope sensing
chapters.intro: Shack-Hartmann, phase diversity, Schlieren and deflectometry.

chapters.title: Polarimetric metrology
chapters.intro: Ellipsometry and scatterometry of films and gratings.

chapters.title: Holography, phase retrieval and computational imaging
chapters.intro: Recovering phase from intensities, shaping intensities with phase, focusing through scattering media and imaging without lenses.

parts.title: Illumination, radiometry and cameras
parts.intro: Watts and lumens, étendue and the design of illumination optics; the optics of cameras and photography.

chapters.title: Radiometry and illumination
chapters.intro: Radiometry and photometry, étendue, nonimaging concentrators, Köhler illumination, homogenizers, speckle, LEDs and freeform beam shaping.

chapters.title: Cameras and photography
chapters.intro: The sensor, bokeh, sunstars, flare, depth of field, image correction and the light field camera.

parts.title: Lasers, nonlinear optics, fibres and detectors
parts.intro: How lasers work, light that changes the medium it travels in, light guided in fibres, and the detectors at the end of the line.

chapters.title: Lasers
chapters.intro: Gain, threshold and modes, Q-switching and mode-locking, laser diodes.

chapters.title: Nonlinear optics
chapters.intro: Second harmonic generation, parametric amplification and the Kerr effect.

chapters.title: Fibre optics
chapters.intro: Light guided in glass fibres and the basics of sending bits through them.

chapters.title: Detectors
chapters.intro: Where the numbers of a detector come from and what photons do to them.

parts.title: Lithography
parts.intro: Projection lithography from the mask to the resist: imaging and resist models, rigorous masks, the projection lens and the illuminator, source and mask optimization, stochastics, and EUV.

chapters.title: Imaging and resist
chapters.intro: Vectorial and Hopkins imaging, process windows, resist and arbitrary layouts.

chapters.title: Masks
chapters.intro: Rigorous mask diffraction with RCWA and FDTD, compared with thin mask models.

chapters.title: Projection lens and illuminator
chapters.intro: The ray traced projection lens across the slit, Jones pupils, telecentricity, the illuminator and lens tolerances.

chapters.title: Optimization and stochastics
chapters.intro: Source optimization, OPC, and the noise of photons and acids.

chapters.title: EUV
chapters.intro: Multilayer mirrors, reflective masks, anamorphic pupils and EUV stochastics.

parts.title: Instruments
parts.intro: Telescopes and the atmosphere, spectrometers, AR/VR and head-up displays, and 3D sensing.

chapters.title: Telescopes, atmosphere and astronomy
chapters.intro: Telescope designs, segmented mirrors, the atmosphere and adaptive optics, coronagraphs, gravitational lenses and rainbows.

chapters.title: Spectroscopy
chapters.intro: Spectrometers and what they measure.

chapters.title: AR/VR and head-up displays
chapters.intro: Waveguide combiners, volume gratings, pancake lenses and windshield HUDs.

chapters.title: 3D sensing and LiDAR
chapters.intro: Time-of-flight and FMCW LiDAR, beam scanners and structured light.
